national_news.title: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand Secure Medal at BWF Badminton World Championships
bullets: The Indian women's doubles pair of Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand secured a medal at the BWF Badminton World Championships in New Delhi by advancing to the semifinals.
They became only the second Indian women's doubles duo to win a World Championships medal, following Jwala Gutta and Ashwini Ponnappa's bronze medal win in London in 2011.
The duo defeated fourth-seeded Chinese pair Jia Yi Fan and Zhang Shu Xian 16-21, 21-15, 21-13 in the quarterfinals.

national_news.title: 14th BRICS STI Ministerial Meeting Calls for Innovation Cooperation in Frontier Tech
bullets: Union Minister Jitendra Singh addressed the 14th BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) Ministerial Meeting hosted in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
India highlighted the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability' for its 2026 BRICS Presidency.
The meeting emphasized deep cooperation in critical sectors including Artificial Intelligence, Quantum Technologies, BioE3 Policy, High-Performance Computing, and Innovation Financing.

national_news.title: PM Modi Highlights Economic Reforms and Growth at ET World Leaders Forum
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Economic Times World Leaders Forum in New Delhi, describing India as a global 'bright spot of growth' amid worldwide economic concerns.
Highlighted the transition from an earlier 'Production Linked Punishment' model to the present 'Production Linked Incentive' (PLI) framework aimed at boosting employment and manufacturing.
Reaffirmed India's commitment to structural policy reforms and highlighted the G20 motto of 'One Earth, One Family, One Future' as a global guiding framework.

national_news.title: PM Modi Interacts with Founders and CEOs of 20 Space Startups in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with CEOs and founders of 20 space startups in New Delhi, including Skyroot Aerospace, Agnikul Cosmos, Pixxel, and Digantara.
Encouraged the space sector to expand applications of space technology into agriculture, livestock management, dairy, and environmental monitoring.
Advocated for greater collaboration between space private enterprises and Atal Tinkering Labs to foster scientific interest among young students.

national_news.title: Indian Doubles Pairs Progress at BWF World Championships 2026
bullets: The Indian men's doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty advanced to the quarterfinals of the BWF World Championships 2026 in New Delhi.
Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand reached the women's doubles quarterfinals by defeating seventh-seeded Japanese pair Rin Iwanaga and Kie Nakanishi.
Former World Champion PV Sindhu, Ayush Shetty, and the mixed doubles pair of Dhruv Kapila and Tanisha Crasto ended their runs in the pre-quarterfinals.

national_news.title: Legendary Odia Playback Singer Pranab Patnaik Passes Away at 88
bullets: Renowned Odia playback singer Pranab Patnaik passed away in Bhubaneswar at the age of 88.
He began his playback singing journey in 1958 and sang in over 200 films, spanning genres like folk, Odissi, devotional, and semi-classical music.
Patnaik was a seven-time Odisha State Film Award winner and a recipient of the prestigious Jayadev Puraskar for his outstanding contribution to Odia cinema.

national_news.title: India and Brazil Sign MoU for Bilateral Telecom and ICT Cooperation
bullets: India and Brazil signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to enhance bilateral cooperation in telecommunications and Information and Communications Technologies (ICTs) on the sidelines of the 12th BRICS Communications Ministers Meeting in Pune.
The MoU was signed by Union Minister of Communications Jyotiraditya M. Scindia and Brazilian Minister of Communications Frederico de Siqueira Filho.
Key focus areas include Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), cybersecurity, universal connectivity, emerging technologies, and joint alignment ahead of India's BRICS Chairship in 2026.

national_news.title: Centre Unveils Delhi Master Plan 2047 for Sustainable Urban Growth
bullets: Union Government unveiled the Delhi Master Plan 2047, aligned with the 'Viksit Bharat 2047' vision, to transform the national capital into a world-class city for nearly 3.2 crore people.
The plan adopts dual planning approaches: area-based redevelopment (brownfield) focusing on Transit Oriented Development (TOD) and Right of Way-based planning for Greenfield areas.
Union Housing and Urban Affairs Minister Manohar Lal announced plans to add around 40 lakh new affordable housing units in the national capital over the coming years.

national_news.title: Sports Ministry Calls for Accelerated Talent Identification for 2036 Olympics
bullets: Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya chaired the 63rd Governing Body Meeting of the Sports Authority of India (SAI).
Emphasized a comprehensive talent identification roadmap across schools, districts, and colleges to build India's athlete pool for the 2036 Olympics.
The Governing Body approved the establishment of the National Coach Accreditation Board to structure coach development.

national_news.title: 35th Manipuri Language Day Celebrated
bullets: The 35th Manipuri Language Day commemorates the inclusion of the Manipuri language in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution on 20th August 1992.
The event was organized by the Manipuri Language Day State Level Celebration Committee in collaboration with the Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy (JNMDA).
The State Government has announced efforts to secure 'Classical Language' status for Manipuri before the next annual celebration.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Approves CoEs for Regional Languages and Receives ₹13,427 Crore Under PMAY
bullets: The Bihar Government announced the establishment of dedicated Centres of Excellence at SCERT Patna for regional languages including Bhojpuri, Magahi, Maithili, and Angika.
SCERT Patna will launch the 'Bihar Vidyavani' podcast and the 'Hamaar Vidyalaya, Hamaar Swabhiman' portal to promote alumni participation in school adoption.

Union Rural Development Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan sanctioned 11.19 lakh pucca houses worth ₹13,427 crore under PMAY and announced the implementation of Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) in Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Chhattisgarh Becomes First Inland State to Export Value-Added Tilapia Products
bullets: Chhattisgarh became the first inland state in India to export value-added Tilapia fish products, dispatching 382 tonnes to the United States.
Under the central scheme Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY), Chhattisgarh has invested nearly ₹900 crore, boosting fish production to approximately 10 lakh tonnes.
The export initiative was reviewed in Raipur by the Secretary, Department of Fisheries (Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying) in partnership with NFDB, MPEDA, and NABARD.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Conducts Statewide TB Screening Drive, Detecting Over 87,600 Cases
bullets: Bihar Health Department screened 2.36 crore people during a statewide Tuberculosis campaign conducted between July 2 and August 14, exceeding the initial target of 1 crore.
A total of 87,623 TB cases were detected, which included 21,550 asymptomatic individuals.
The drive utilized advanced infrastructure including 491 digital X-ray machines (140 AI-powered handheld units), 89 CBNAAT machines, and 562 Truenat machines.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Introduces 'One Officer, One Model School' System for Education Governance
bullets: The Bihar state leadership announced the 'One Officer, One Model School' initiative to assign state education officials to specific model schools (Saraswati Vidya Niketan) for direct oversight.
The model mandates quarterly parent-teacher meetings, enhanced alumni engagement, and regular inspections to raise academic standards.
Officials were directed to provide specialized academic resources and coaching support for competitive exams such as JEE and NEET to high-performing students in government schools.

bihar_news.title: Sheikhpura Resident Transforms Life Through PMFME Scheme in Bihar
bullets: Sanjit Kumar from Sheikhpura district in Bihar successfully set up a large-scale bakery unit by securing credit support under the Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PM-FME) scheme.

The PMFME scheme was launched in 2020 under the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyaan to enhance the competitiveness of existing individual micro-enterprises in the unorganized segment of the food processing industry.

The scheme provides financial, technical, and business support to address key challenges such as lack of access to institutional credit, modern technology, packaging, branding, and organized market linkages.
